summary: Tested Paid World Winners end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass against the isolated loopback API (self-seeded DB test_pw_iter54, now dropped). Real object storage was checked on preview with a separate script: cover/gallery image+video upload, public streaming, reorder, delete, and round clip/screenshot streaming all work. UI checks: approvals (kind/status filters, wallet select, approve & credit once, visibility toggle), Publish section (switches, order, cover upload, gallery upload with caption, reorder, round-media hide/show), Hall of Winners in My Account (3 tabs, cards, detail, back, masked names, leaderboard, gallery, lightbox image/video playback, Esc/close), the /winners redirect, and admin contests phases, tabs and Draw button. Everything works except 1 UI bug: the lightbox is not fullscreen and is clipped (badly on mobile). There is also 1 minor count bug.

minor.issue: 'counts' is passed through from draw_studio_ops list_winners. It counts ALL winners, including promo_ contests, and ignores the kind filter. Preview shows Pending (7) but only 5 non-promo pending rows exist (2 promo_drawstudio_test winners are included). With kind=leaderboard the tab still shows Pending (7) while the list is empty. Fix: compute counts from the filtered non-promo rows (respect kind).

The whole file is read into memory and returned as one Response with no HTTP Range/206 support. Video files can be up to 150 MB. iOS Safari needs byte-range responses to play <video>, and seeking won't work. Recommend StreamingResponse with Range handling (or signed URLs).
Only removes the DB reference; the object-storage file is orphaned. Also returns ok:true for unknown ids (no 404).
Does not check that the contest or recording exists. It upserts a paid_winner_publication doc for any cid.

ui_bugs.issue: The lightbox is NOT fullscreen. Its position:fixed overlay sits inside <div className='pw-rise' data-testid='pw-detail'>. The pw-rise animation (fill-mode both) leaves a computed transform (matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)), which makes that div the containing block, and the ancestor paid-winners-page has overflow-hidden, so the overlay is clipped. Desktop: overlay is 1040x497 inside the card, with the site header and ticker still visible. Mobile 390px: overlay box y=-379, h=893, partly off-screen and clipped. Fix: render Lightbox through createPortal(..., document.body), or remove pw-rise/transform from the DetailView wrapper.

issues: The tab bar scrolls sideways and the 3rd tab 'Draw Gallery' is cut off at the right edge with no scroll hint (scrollbar hidden).
Status tab counts don't match the kind filter or the list (see backend minor issue).
Contests without image or cover show an empty dark area. end_date is a naive datetime parsed as local time (could be off by a day near midnight).

action_items: HIGH: Make the Hall of Winners lightbox truly fullscreen: portal Lightbox to document.body (createPortal) or drop the transform-based pw-rise animation from the pw-detail wrapper. Verify at 390px.
Fix /api/admin/paid-winners/winners counts: exclude promo_ winners and respect the kind filter.
Consider Range/streaming responses for public video media (iOS Safari playback, 150MB memory reads).
Optional: delete the storage object on media delete; validate contest/recording in the round-media visibility endpoint; add a scroll hint for the mobile tab bar.
critical_code_review_comments: paid_winners_routes.approve: idempotency is solid (paid_out short-circuit + adjust_single_wallet op id paid_winner_credit:{id}:main/bonus). Leaderboard winners also get prize_bonus_tokens credited to winning_bonus (verified +5).
_mask treats '@' as a separator, so a raw email user_name like 'john@x.com' becomes 'John X.'. This is acceptable but leaks the domain initial.
WinnersHall tab switching has no request cancellation, so a fast tab switch could show the previous tab's list (race).
seed_data_creation: Preview DB: temporarily seeded c_test_pw_ui_skill (+3 game_scores, winner w_test_pw_ui_lb credited to winning_bonus via UI) and c_test_pw_ph_await/c_test_pw_ph_live. Uploaded TEST gallery/cover media to c_drawstudio_e2e. Everything was removed afterwards and ds_test_user_9's wallet credit was reverted (now 0). c_drawstudio_e2e publication is unchanged (show_winners+show_gallery, media []). Isolated DB test_pw_iter54 was dropped. Existing c_drawstudio_test pending winners were not touched. Free World was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend/tests/conftest.py blocks non-loopback HTTP. Run the suite with: cd /app/backend; TEST_DB_NAME=test_pw_iterNN nohup bash scripts/run_isolated_test_api.sh & then /app/.venv/bin/python scripts/seed_isolated_test_db.py, then TEST_DB_NAME=... bash scripts/run_isolated_backend_tests.sh tests/test_paid_winners.py. Use a fresh TEST_DB_NAME if /tmp/prizeleague_test_creds.env was regenerated. Object storage is unavailable in the isolated API, so media upload/stream must be checked on preview (script pattern in /tmp/preview_media_check.py). Lightbox check: bounding box of [data-testid=winners-lightbox] should equal the viewport.
rca of the issue: Lightbox clipping: .pw-rise { animation: pw-rise ... both } keeps the last keyframe applied, and Chrome reports a computed transform matrix on #pw-detail. Any transform creates a containing block for position:fixed descendants, so inset-0 resolves to pw-detail's box, and paid-winners-page overflow-hidden clips it. Reproduce: /my-account/contest-winners -> Draw Gallery -> open card -> click tile -> lightbox is boxed inside the card (desktop) or off-screen (mobile). Fix: createPortal to document.body.
